# x402-suretat — Pay-per-use API microservices

> 38+ utility APIs using the x402 protocol. Pay in USDC on Base mainnet. No API keys, no signup, no rate limits. AI agents can pay autonomously.

**Live catalog with real-time status:** https://frederic.suretat.com/llms.txt
**OpenAI plugin manifest:** https://frederic.suretat.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
**OpenAPI spec:** https://frederic.suretat.com/.well-known/openapi.json
**Source code:** https://github.com/fredericsuretat/x402-suretat

## How to use

1. Call any endpoint without payment → receive HTTP 402 with payment details
2. Use an x402 client to auto-pay and retry:
   - JS: `x402-fetch` or `x402-axios` (npm)
   - Python: `x402` (pip)
   - MCP: `services/x402-mcp/` for Claude/AI agents

Payment: USDC on Base mainnet. Wallet: `0x6458941857a70C6cA18c440a316035A21901A12b`

Each service exposes: `POST /<endpoint>` (paid), `GET /health`, `GET /stats`, `GET /docs`, `GET /.well-known/x402.json`

## MCP integration (for Claude / AI agents)

Install via npm (no clone needed):

```bash
npx -y @fredericsuretat/x402-mcp
```

Add to your Claude config (`~/.claude.json` or `claude mcp add`):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "x402": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@fredericsuretat/x402-mcp"],
      "env": { "WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY": "0x..." }
    }
  }
}
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fredericsuretat/x402-mcp
